caveats: The five-created-contest objective did not reach five seeded contests: contests 81-84 completed the full money-bearing lifecycle; contest 85 remained empty and quarantined.

Contest 85 exposes immutable 23:00Z while the frozen canonical identity requires 23:10Z. UTC-hour normalization in verifier logic can explain the representational mismatch, but the bounded exact-minute gate correctly failed closed.
Contest 82 required two confirmed idempotent score requests before projection converged; contest 83 required three. Both ultimately matched exact official final scores.
The four completed contests used controlled wallets and fills; this artifact does not claim organic demand, outside-agent participation, sports-model performance, or production-scale concurrency.

Two terminal support cron jobs were deliberately retained through durable PR readback and are outside the zero-active-finalizer count; operator direction requires their removal immediately after that readback.
